sections.title: Everything you need to plan a great session
sections.content:
Flexible block types

Use the built-in categories or create your own to match your facilitation style:

  • Input & Presentation – Knowledge transfer and expert input
  • Exercises & Activities – Hands-on learning and practice
  • Discussion – Structured conversation and reflection
  • Breaks – Rest, coffee, transition time
  • Energisers – Re-engage the room between heavy sessions

Groups & Breakout Sessions

  • Groups – Collapse related blocks into named phases for a cleaner view
  • Breakout sessions – Plan parallel tracks for different groups simultaneously

Auto-calculated timing

  • Live clock – Set a start time and Sessionplan shows exactly when every block begins and ends. Total duration updates as you edit.

Live Mode

  • Run your session – Activate Live Mode during your workshop. A slim bar shows the current block, time remaining, and what's coming next – so you can focus on the room, not the clock.

Block library & templates

  • Library – Save favourite blocks and reuse them across sessions
  • Templates – Store recurring formats and spin up new agendas in seconds

Export & sharing

  • Share link – Encode your entire agenda in a single URL. No file attachments.
  • JSON export/import – Back up your work or transfer it to another device

sections.title: Sessionplan vs. SessionLab – what's the difference?
sections.content:
SessionLab is a solid tool for teams with budget. Sessionplan is built for facilitators who want to get started immediately – for free, without friction:

For a more detailed breakdown of where Sessionplan fits in the wider tool landscape, see our workshop planning tools comparison.

  • 100% free – No trial period, no freemium limits, no credit card
  • No account needed – Your first agenda is one click away
  • Privacy-first – Everything stays in your browser by default; optional server sync via Dynamic Link.
  • Fast to learn – Intuitive enough to use without reading a manual

sections.title: Who is Sessionplan for?
sections.content:
Anyone who designs and runs structured sessions will feel at home:

  • Trainers & coaches – Structure multi-day programmes and one-off sessions
  • Facilitators & consultants – Design workshops from strategy days to design sprints
  • Scrum Masters & Agile coaches – Plan retrospectives, sprint plannings and PI ceremonies
  • Teachers & lecturers – Prep lesson plans with clear phases and timings

Teachers get a dedicated experience through our lesson planning tool, which uses the same visual-timeline engine with phase types tuned for the classroom. Agile teams running regular ceremonies will find our retrospective planner useful too.

items.question: Is Sessionplan really free?
items.answer: Yes – completely. No hidden fees, no premium tier, no expiring trial. All features are available from day one at sessionplan.de.

items.question: Do I need to create an account?
items.answer: No. Open Sessionplan.de and start building. Your agendas are saved locally in your browser by default. Use Dynamic Link to save your plan to the server for a stable URL.

items.question: How do I share my agenda with co-facilitators or clients?
items.answer: Use the Share button to generate a link. Anyone with the link can open your full agenda in their browser. You can also export to JSON and import it on any device.

items.question: Can I use Sessionplan offline?
items.answer: Once loaded, the app runs entirely in your browser – no internet connection required. Plan your next workshop on the train.

items.question: What happens if I close the tab?
items.answer:
Your work is auto-saved to localStorage. The next time you open Sessionplan.de, you'll be offered to restore your last session.
